newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner shipyard wins NOK 500 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner shipyard wins NOK 500 mln deal.

text.p: Kvaerner ASA said on Friday its 75 percent-owned Kvaerner Vyborg shipyard in Russia had won a 500 million crown contract to build 10 standby vessels for Summer Wind Navigation Inc.
Kvaerner said the vessels would be delivered during 1998 and 1999.

In a statement, Diderik Schnitler, Kvaerner executive vice president, said the deal would enable the company to lay the foundations for developing Vyborg into a modern shipyard and to provide a bridgehead for Kvaerner into Russia.

The order book for the Vyborg yard includes the upgrading of the drilling rig Ilion (Shelf 8) for use in deepwaters, the installation of rocket-launching equipment for the Sea Launch platform and construction of a 1,000-tonne utility module for oil extraction in the Caspian Sea, Kvaerner's statement said.
